EntryKind.description: What the entry lists (VTI-VTN-031): a community, whose entries are its members, or a network, whose entries are further listings. A listing credential carries the same fact as `nodeType` `VTC` or `VTN`.

EntryState.description: `listed`: the network lists the party and the party has not answered; this is never membership (VTI-VTN-013). `acknowledged`: the party acknowledged the network's grant; it is a member. `repudiated`: the party rejected the listing. `suspended`: the network suspended the membership; reversible. `removed`: the network ended the entry. `departed`: the party left, by repudiating the grant.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

FederatedEntry.description: A result from a member network's set, with the network that lists it and the path to that network.

acknowledged.description: Whether the party is a member. Every result states it (VTI-VTN-013).

listedBy.description: The network whose set the result is in.

listingId.description: The listing credential's `id`, to fetch it.

path.description: From the searched network to `listedBy`, one hop per nesting.

MembersOnly.description: Only members (`acknowledged: true`). Absent means false.

Membership.description: A person's membership credential (VMC) from a community that is a member of this network, holder-bound to the requester's identity. Open for the same reason as `Credential`.

PathHop.description: One step on the path from the searched network to the network that lists a result. Each hop states its own entry state: membership does not chain (VTI-VTN-033).

acknowledged.description: Whether that entry is a membership.

state.description: Its own entry's state at the network before it on the path.

Response.description: The matches, each with the network that lists it and its path, and the member networks that could not be searched.

determinedAt.description: When the network assembled the answer.

results.description: The matches, this network's own first (empty `path`), each stating its own state and whether it is a member of `listedBy`.

unreachable.description: Member networks whose sets could not be searched: indeterminate, not absent (VTI-REG-012).

Response.title: VTN Directory — Federated Search — response payload

SearchText.description: Free text. Every whitespace-separated term must match, case-insensitively, the entry's DID, label, description or a tag.

Unreachable.description: A member network whose set could not be read: its results are indeterminate, not absent (VTI-REG-012).

network.description: The member network that could not be searched.
